# COLVER Systems
> Architecture for Real-Time Operations. Bespoke business software, high-concurrency web systems, digital commerce rails, and deterministic AI extraction workflows.

## Overview
Colver is an independent software architecture and product engineering studio based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. We partner with Indian enterprises, SMEs, and high-growth digital brands to design, engineer, and deploy high-performance custom software systems that replace rigid off-the-shelf SaaS packages and fragmented spreadsheets.

- Location: Indiranagar, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560038, India
- Coordinates: 12.9716° N, 77.5946° E
- Founded: 2024
- Primary Website: https://colver.in
- Inquiries & Support: contact@colver.in

## Core Engineering Capabilities
1. Custom Business Systems & ERPs: Tailored multi-warehouse inventory ledgers, pessimistic stock reservation, role-based approval workflows, and immutable audit logs.
2. High-Concurrency Web Platforms: Server-rendered Next.js 16 architectures, sub-100ms interaction latency, real-time WebSocket state synchronization, and zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
3. E-Commerce & Transaction Rails: Unified Indian payment gateway integrations (Razorpay UPI, Cashfree, PayU, Stripe), automated GST-compliant tax invoices, and idempotent payment reconciliation.
4. AI Document Intelligence & Automation: Deterministic OCR and cognitive parsing converting unstructured supplier invoices, PDF bills, and manifests into validated relational database records.
5. Enterprise API & Gateway Mesh: High-throughput typed REST and GraphQL gateways with token-bucket rate limiting and logistics carrier integrations (Shiprocket, Delhivery).

## Architectural Guarantees & Philosophy
- 100% Intellectual Property Ownership: Clients receive full copyright, unminified source code, Docker configs, and database migration scripts upon project completion. Zero proprietary lock-in and zero monthly seat taxes.
- Immutability & Functional Integrity: Unidirectional data flow, pure transformations across boundaries, and deterministic state transitions.
- Security at the Boundary: Strict Zod validation schemas, Content Security Policy (CSP) headers, least-privilege database roles, and zero hardcoded secrets.
- Performance: Sub-second edge transitions, sub-15ms database queries, and sub-100ms INP.

## Deployed Flagship Production Systems
- Nexus Workflow Engine: Multi-warehouse operational canvas supporting 14 distribution hubs with pessimistic locking and sub-40ms edge synchronization.
- Apex Transaction Core: High-throughput checkout engine handling 40,000 requests/minute with automated GST tax invoicing and sub-180ms UPI authorization.
- Pulse Observability Portal: Enterprise telemetry streaming ClickHouse metrics and Core Web Vitals across South Asia edge nodes.
- Aura Architectural Tokens: Universal design system with accessible ARIA state machines and zero runtime bundle overhead.

## Pricing & Sprint Models
- 2-Week Architecture Blueprint Sprint: Full operational audit, database schema design, and interactive UI contract prototypes.
- 6-Week Release Core: Full-stack production MVP shipped on private staging with automated CI/CD and security hardening.
- Dedicated Engineering Retainer: Continuous high-velocity feature iterations, database query tuning, and 24/7 SLA uptime monitoring.
